name: Nicolae Ștefănuță - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for Displaced Workers following an application from Finland – EGF/2026/003 FI/Valmet Automotive
part_text:
The European Parliament approves giving Finland 410,310 euros from a European Union fund that helps workers who lose their jobs. The money comes after car maker Valmet Automotive in western Finland cut hundreds of jobs. It pays for 60 percent of a 683,850 euro support package for 233 workers: help finding work, career coaching, vocational and language training, safety certificates, start-up grants and wage subsidies. Parliament also asks Finland to report on how well the support worked.

- **What changes:** Finland gets 410,310 euros to help 233 former Valmet Automotive workers.
- **Who it affects:** Laid-off workers in western Finland, many over 54 or with little education.
- **What happens next:** Finland runs the training and job help until 2028, then reports results.
